answer_2.quote: We compare xCoRe performances against the current available systems for medium-size, long- and cross-document coreference... We report the scores shown in the recent work of [citation] in which they test Mistral-7B and LLamax3-70B on cross-document tasks... Specifically, we detail the results of xCoRe with a version that starts from gold mentions (performing clustering and merging steps) and a version that starts from gold clusters (performing merging only).
